references.text: The Israelites did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses—the same formula of obedience showing that the people followed the Lord's command through Moses.
Moses mustered them according to the Lord's command—the same expression 'by the word of the Lord' (עַל־פִּי יְהוָה) is used regarding the muster.
The descendants of Kohath were mustered just as the Lord had commanded through Moses—part of the same account of the muster.
The descendants of Gershon were mustered just as the Lord had commanded through Moses—part of the same account of the muster.
The descendants of Merari were mustered just as the Lord had commanded through Moses—part of the same account of the muster.
The service of the Levites at the tabernacle under the leadership of Ithamar—referring to the duties and tasks of the Levites.
The Levites were assigned tasks according to their service—each man according to his service (עֲבֹדָה).
They broke camp by the command of the Lord through Moses—the same expression about acting according to the word of the Lord through Moses.
Obedience to the command of the Lord through Moses—the importance of following what the Lord commanded through Moses.
